subject: Interesting...I use a Saitek
author: Khanon
body:
Interesting...I use a Saitek 2600 Rumble Pad and it didn't recoginze, per se, either. However, once I manually configured the controller to do what I wanted, it worked fine. It programmed the same way most other games do it for me...with the exception of GRID which was a cluster....you-know-what...for any but the handful of supported controllers (most of which not even really mainstream ones).

*shrugs* Guess I'm just used to having to program my controller. lol

But yeah, I would have thought it would have recognzied a Thrustmaster PS3 style pad...

 

No more games, no more teasing. Time to play...time to die. --Pinhead

subject: Alternative Controller Support
author: Abernyte
body:
Overall have a very favorable impression of the PC version of BP. I am somewhat dissapointed that it will only recognize a XBox controller for PC (per the documentation and personal experience). I have a PS3 style controller made by Thrustmaster that it won't recognize. I can program the controller to use the appropriate keyboard controlls but would prefer native support.

Otherwise pretty much loving it.
